note: Amber's refusal templates (addendum v4.2 section 69.5, ruling D5). Authored as data from the start -- parser.py renders these, it does not compose message text inline. `readings` is applied once per candidate reading and the results are joined; `headline`, `reason`, and `fix` are each applied once. Every {slot} is filled by the site that raises the refusal.

templates.headline: line {line}: two readings are possible here, and nothing says which
templates.reason: both {names} are defined, so the parser will not choose between them
templates.fix: try: parenthesise the one you mean -- `{suggestion}` -- or rename one of the functions so only one reading is possible

templates.headline: line {line}: `{head} {next}` reads two ways, and nothing says which
templates.reason: `{head}` takes an argument and `{next}` is also a defined function, so the parser will not choose between them
templates.fix: try: `{head} ({next})` to call `{next}` first and pass its result to `{head}` -- or write them as two separate statements if you meant them apart

templates.headline: line {line}: whether `{subject}` takes an argument here is not known
templates.reason: the arity of `{subject}` is not known here
templates.fix: declare it, or call it with `of` so the argument is explicit

templates.headline: line {line}: two readings are possible here, and nothing says which
templates.reason: `{head}` takes exactly one argument, so both readings have the right shape
templates.fix: try: `{head}({paren_expr})` with nothing after the parens on this call, or restructure so `{head}` clearly applies to just one thing

templates.headline: line {line}: whether `{head}` takes one argument here is not known
templates.reason: the arity of `{head}` is not known here
templates.fix: declare it, or call it with `of` so the argument is explicit

templates.headline: line {line}: `{source}` reads two ways, and nothing says which
templates.reason: more than one exported name matches this text, so the parser will not choose between them
templates.fix: try: rename to match only one exported name exactly -- a shorter or longer phrase
